name: KommerceKit Wholesale – B2B Wholesale Pricing, Minimum Orders & Quick Order Form for WooCommerce
author: kommercekit

sections.description:
Approve wholesale customers and get your first B2B checkout in under an hour with role-based prices, login-to-view, customer approvals, order minimums, and a fast Quick Order page (Lite).

Why KommerceKit Wholesale?
Other “do-everything” wholesale plugins can overwhelm you with rules and settings. KommerceKit Wholesale focuses on the clean, fast path to your first wholesale orders, then scales up when you’re ready.

What you’ll get (Free)

1) Role-based wholesale pricing (simple & clear)
– Wholesale price fields on products and variations.
– Assign a wholesale role to a customer and they’ll see wholesale pricing automatically.
– Optional per-product minimum order quantity (MOQ).

2) Control who sees what
– Login-to-view: hide prices from visitors until they log in.
– Show/hide Add to Cart for guests or non-wholesale users.

3) Approve the right customers
– Streamlined Wholesale Registration flow (page + form).
– Manual approval with email notifications.
– Auto-assign the correct wholesale role on approval.

4) Protect your margins
– Minimum order subtotal for wholesale carts.
– Payment & shipping method limits for wholesale roles (simple toggles).

5) Quick Order (Lite) – fast bulk buying
– One table to search by name/SKU and add multiple products at once.
– Variation pickers inline (no product page detour).
– Quantity inputs, keyboard-friendly, and sticky totals with “Add all to cart”.

Made for store owners & devs
– Woo standards: HPOS compatible, Woo email classes, i18n/a11y minded.
– Works with your theme; minimal CSS, clean markup.
– Extensible actions/filters for agencies and customizations.

How it works (3 quick steps)

  1. Enable KommerceKit Wholesale and run the quick setup.
  2. Create a Wholesale role (or use the default) and set product/variation prices.
  3. Publish your Wholesale Registration page and approve your first buyer.

You’re live. Share the page, approve customers, and watch your first wholesale orders come in.

Features

  • Wholesale user roles (create multiple).
  • Product & variation-level wholesale price fields.
  • MOQ (per product) and minimum order subtotal (cart level).
  • Login-to-view prices; hide add-to-cart for non-wholesale.
  • Wholesale registration page + manual approvals.
  • Payment & shipping restrictions per wholesale role.
  • Quick Order (Lite) block/shortcode for fast bulk ordering.
  • HPOS-ready, internationalization, accessibility-minded.
  • Actions/filters for developers.

Quick Order (Lite)

A lightweight, modern order table that helps B2B buyers add many products fast:
– Search by product name or SKU.
– Choose variations inline.
– Set quantities and add everything in one click.
– Keyboard-first UX, compact design, sticky totals.

Blocks

  • Wholesale Registration – Add the application form anywhere.
  • Quick Order (Lite) – Fast order table for approved wholesale users.

Upgrade to Pro (when you’re ready)

Grow into advanced capabilities such as:
– Tiered/quantity-break pricing, role & category rules.
– Category visibility controls and catalog segmentation.
– Cart rules (free shipping thresholds, role-based coupons).
– Advanced Quick Order (filters, saved lists, CSV import, multi-warehouse).
– Quote/PO workflows and more.

Developer Notes

  • Built with WordPress/WooCommerce standards.
  • Uses Woo email classes for native notifications.
  • Hooks/filters documented in the code for integrations.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate KommerceKit Wholesale – B2B Wholesale Pricing, Minimum Orders & Quick Order Form for WooCommerce.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → KommerceKit Wholesale and run the setup wizard.
  3. Create a Wholesale role (or keep the default).
  4. Add wholesale prices to products/variations.
  5. Publish the Wholesale Registration page (created for you) and test the flow.
  6. Add the Quick Order (Lite) block/shortcode to a page and share with approved users.
sections.faq:
Does it work with my theme?

Yes. KommerceKit Wholesale outputs minimal, semantic markup and light CSS. The Quick Order (Lite) table inherits your theme typography and buttons.

Is it HPOS compatible?

Yes, KommerceKit Wholesale is compatible with WooCommerce’s High-Performance Order Storage.

Can I restrict payment/shipping for wholesale orders?

Yes, you can toggle allowed methods per wholesale role.

How do approvals work?

New applicants submit your Wholesale Registration form. You review and approve; they’re assigned a wholesale role and notified via Woo emails.

Is there a Quick Order in Free?

Yes. Quick Order (Lite) is included. It’s fast, modern, and perfect for small catalogs or starter workflows.
